name: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle's Head
summary: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle's Head marks the end of a threat to Red Cloud Mesa. The Bristleback leader threatened the young tauren braves, and his head was recovered from deep in Brambleblade Ravine as proof of victory.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: The Bristleback quilboar of Brambleblade Ravine have attacked the tribes of Camp Narache. Their chieftain, Sharptusk Thornmantle, urges them on. The tauren seek to protect their homeland in Mulgore with vigilance and strength. Sharptusk's head proves he is dead and warns the surviving quilboar clans against encroaching on the mesa borders.

sections.title: A Lesson in the Hunt
sections.body: Brave Windfeather demands Sharptusk's head as a rite of passage for young hunters and tribal defenders. Facing an enemy clever enough to strike back and lead a war band tests a young combatant's martial skill. Presenting the head fulfills that trial and earns the young fighter a reputation among the braves of Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Why does Brave Windfeather want the head of Sharptusk Thornmantle?
faq.answer: Brave Windfeather wants proof that the Bristleback chieftain has fallen. Sharptusk can no longer direct raids against Camp Narache, and the head warns the remaining quilboar that their aggression will meet decisive force.
Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle led the Bristleback quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine, on Red Cloud Mesa's eastern edge. Under his command, the Bristlebacks harassed and attacked young tauren braves.

aliases: where do i find the head
faq.answer: You obtain the head by killing Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle in his makeshift tribal village, deep inside Brambleblade Ravine east of Camp Narache.

angles.text: As a tauren, claiming a formidable enemy's head marks an important step for a young defender. It proves you have the resolve and skill to protect your people's new home.
As a hunter, Sharptusk is prey that can hunt back. Tracking and striking such an intelligent foe tests your skill.
